name: Hive Backed Dollar
oneLiner: HBD is Hive's algorithmic dollar, redeemable on-chain for $1 of HIVE via a witness-set conversion, with haircut rules when system debt exceeds thresholds.
collateral: Hive protocol value and conversion rules between HBD and HIVE, including haircut logic when HBD debt exceeds protocol thresholds
pegMechanism: Protocol-level conversion mechanism targets one U.S. dollar of HIVE per HBD, with witness-set interest and haircut rules under stress

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata or audit notes identify direct seizure, freeze, blacklist, privileged burn, proxy-upgrade, or chain-governance intervention authority despite decentralized governance labeling.

notices.title: Protocol haircut mechanism
notices.message: HBD redemptions depend on Hive protocol conversion rules and can be haircut when system debt is above configured thresholds.

notices.title: Hive-native asset
notices.message: HBD is issued by the Hive protocol rather than an EVM-style token contract. Pharos does not list a contract address until Hive is supported in the chain metadata registry.

mintAuthority.summary: HBD is created at the Hive protocol layer through a HIVE<->HBD conversion mechanism; supply expands when HIVE is converted to HBD, bounded by a debt-ratio cap and haircut rule, with the witness consensus set tuning conversion/interest parameters via soft-fork without a hard fork.

controls.label: Hive conversion mechanism (protocol-level mint/burn)
controls.capDescription: HBD is minted via on-chain HIVE->HBD conversion (3.5-day time-averaged HIVE price); a dynamic debt-ratio cap stops HBD printing and a haircut reduces HBD->HIVE conversion value once HBD debt exceeds the configured share of HIVE market cap.
controls.evidence: Conversion is enforced by Hive consensus code, not a permissioned minter; users mint HBD by converting HIVE and supply is bounded by the debt cap / haircut rule.

controls.label: Hive witness consensus set (parameter governance)
controls.evidence: Block-producing witnesses set HBD interest/savings APR and can adjust the haircut/debt-limit parameters via consensus without a hard fork; they tune issuance terms but do not directly mint to arbitrary accounts.

review.evidence: Hive docs and reputable coverage describe HBD as protocol-issued via a HIVE<->HBD conversion contract with a debt-ratio cap and haircut rule; witnesses tune conversion/interest parameters through consensus rather than a discretionary minter role.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Conversion/haircut mechanism and witness parameter control confirmed from Hive docs and coverage; exact current debt-ratio threshold values and per-witness authority not independently read from consensus code.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the current numeric debt-ratio cap and haircut activation threshold from live Hive consensus parameters.
